tagline: Your village's voice. Verified local news, right at your fingertips. No login, no barriers — just the truth.
hero_description: Notices, updates and services from your Gram Panchayat — all in one place.
about_description: GramVartha connects your Gram Panchayat with the people of your village. Get important notices, discover government schemes, and raise complaints — all in one place.
about_panchayat_description: Publish village notices, upload government schemes, and view complaints from villagers.
about_villagers_description: Stay updated with notices and schemes, and raise complaints directly with your Gram Panchayat.
how_description: From your Panchayat's first registration to everyday communication with villagers.
how_step_1_description: Your Gram Panchayat registers the village on GramVartha and creates its digital village space.
how_step_2_description: Panchayat administrators and authorised officials get access to manage notices, schemes and complaints.
how_step_3_description: Villagers download the GramVartha app to access their village information anytime, anywhere.
how_step_4_description: Access QR-based notices, complaints, Work Guide, government schemes and the Scheme Assistant.
how_step_5_description: Get important village updates, weather advisories and useful information directly through GramVartha.
admin_login_description: Access your GramVartha administration portal to manage villages, publish notices, and keep your community connected.
admin_login_mobile_description: Access your GramVartha administration portal and manage your village digitally.
admin_register_description: Create your superadmin account to manage villages, publish notices, and oversee community governance through GramVartha.
admin_register_mobile_description: Create your superadmin account to manage villages, notices, schemes, and community governance.
admin_register_form_description: Register a new superadmin account to get started.
admin_password_hint: Use a strong password with a combination of letters, numbers, and symbols.
admin_sign_in_instead: Already have an account? Sign in
official_login_desktop_description: Access your Panchayat account to manage village information, notices, schemes and citizen complaints.
official_login_account_description: One place to keep your village connected and informed.
official_login_mobile_description: Sign in to manage your Panchayat and stay connected with your village.
official_register_desktop_description: Register as an official of your Gram Panchayat and help keep your village connected, informed and accessible.
official_register_account_description: One account to manage village information and communicate with citizens.
official_register_mobile_description: Register as a Panchayat official and help keep your village connected and informed.
features_title: Made for rural India, powered by community
feature1_desc: Scan any QR code to instantly view official village notices, announcements, and updates — no login required.
feature2_desc: Content available in Marathi and other local languages, ensuring every villager can read and understand important information.
feature3_desc: All notices and news are verified by trained community journalists before publishing, ensuring accuracy and reliability.
feature4_desc: Access GramVartha from any smartphone, tablet, or computer — designed to work even on low-bandwidth connections.
footer_cta_title: Ready to bring transparency to your village?
footer_cta_desc: Join the growing network of villages using GramVartha.
footer_description: GramVartha is a community-driven platform bringing verified local news and official notices to rural communities across India.
